name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Well, it's finally time for the Murakumo Martial Festival to begin！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「What do you think, Sakura-san? Look at how pumped up the crowd is！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「As a Murakumo Academy alumna yourself, this must hold a very special place in your heart！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Man, this brings back so many memories~！ I was stiff as a board with nerves during the Martial Festival main tournament too」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「My teacher had to smack me on the ass to fire me up！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Getting nervous before a match—it's hard to imagine that from the notorious heel Sakura we know today」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Hey, hey! Even I used to be a bubbly little schoolgirl back in the day, y'know~!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Once again this year, an incredible lineup of swordsmen have earned their spots in the main tournament」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now, let's introduce our competitors one by one！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Entry No. 1, Tennouji Victoria！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Last year, she beat out the third-years to take a stunning victory, claiming the title of Toujinegi as a mere second-year！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now a Martial Arts Division third-year, how do you rate Victoria this year, Sakura-san？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Even in last year's matches, Victoria put her overwhelming power and Barrier Jacket on full display」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Her actual technique was a little shaky, though」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「If she's patched up that weakness completely, she's gonna be totally unstoppable this year！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Will she manage to defend her title as Toujinegi！？ Keep your eyes glued to the matches ahead！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Entry No. 2, Arima Rin！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「A Martial Arts Division third-year, she narrowly fell short in last year's preliminaries, but this year she's made a triumphant leap into the main tournament」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Her determination riding on this year's tournament must be second to none！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, for third-years, this is their very last shot at the Martial Festival」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Throw everything you've got at it and fight 'til you burn out！ Give 'em hell！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Entry No. 3, Igarashi Taiga！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「A Martial Arts Division third-year who fell to Victoria in last year's semifinals」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Man, that match was seriously close~！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「If her opponent hadn't been Victoria, I’m sure she would’ve had the skill to make it all the way to the finals！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Will she get her revenge this year? I can’t wait to see!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Entry No. 4, Kazamine Setsugekka！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Believe it or not, she’s made it to the main tournament as just a first-year in the Martial Arts Division！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura-san, the Kazamine name is quite prominent even within the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association, isn't it?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I never really got the impression that Kazamine was all that skilled in the martial arts before now.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「But for her to fight her way into the main tournament like this... that’s the real deal！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「I’m dying to see what kind of performance she’ll put on！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Entry No. 5, Arakawa Sonomi！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「A second-year in the Martial Arts Division, she made it to the main tournament last year but lost in the first round. She’s fully prepared for her main tournament appearance this year！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I was a little curious, so I watched the video of her qualifying matches—this one is pretty interesting！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「She’s a nagamaki wielder, of all things. I’ve never even fought one myself！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I’d love to see her come to the Pro League！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ooh! A passionate love call from Nakamura-senshu! There's no way she can lose after that!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Entry No. 6, Kuki Asahi！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura-san, I hear Kuki-senshu is the younger sister of Kuki Takahisa, who became a Toujinegi a few years back.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Ah, Kuki Takahisa of the Iai drawing style！ I know that name！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「If I remember right, he was a first-year when I was in my third year. He was one hell of a tough kid！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「That was the year Takahisa kept me from becoming Toujinegi. Even thinking about it now makes me so damn frustrated！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「She’s also a master of the Iai drawing style, just like Takahisa-senshu.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「You serious? I can’t take my eyes off this one!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Entry No. 7, Suzakuin Momiji！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Well, she’s finally here！ I’m sure everyone has been waiting on the edge of their seats for her entrance！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, I doubt there’s anyone who doesn't know the name Suzakuin.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Competitor Momiji is the granddaughter of the current Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association chairman, Masamori Suzakuin.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「She’s truly carrying the prestige of the academy on her back, making her long-awaited appearance. What do you think of Competitor Momiji, Sakura？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「The hell with the Suzakuins！ Family pedigree means nothing to me！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Strength—that’s all that matters！ If you’ve got a problem with that, bring it on anytime！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa, look at that! Competitor Sakura has her feet up on the table! She’s truly the ‘Fighting Dog of the Flower Storm’—fearsome as they come!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And for our final entrant, Entry No. 8, Competitor Minamoto Shizuku！！！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「First off, though, how the hell are you in the Technical Division when you’re strong enough to compete in the Martial Festival！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「You’re making the Martial Arts Division folks look like total jokes！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Please calm down, Sakura！ If you stomp on the table like that, it’s going to break！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Then again, she’s of the direct Minamoto line, so I guess it’s no wonder she’s strong.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Only the Suzakuin Family has ever been awarded the titles of Toujinegi and Saisho simultaneously.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「If Competitor Shizuku wins, she might be the first person outside the Suzakuin Family to hold both at once！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Oh, now that’s something to look forward to. I’m rooting for her！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And with that, all eight contestants for this year’s main tournament have been decided. Sakura, who are you most looking forward to？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Well, number one has gotta be Suzakuin Momiji, right?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I said family pedigree doesn't matter, but I’m definitely curious about her.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「It’d be impossible not to look forward to seeing what kind of matches a Suzakuin shows us at this Martial Festival！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Runner-up is, of course, the reigning Toujinegi, Tennouji Victoria.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I just don't think there’s any other student at this academy who can stand toe-to-toe with Victoria’s overwhelming power.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「She’s a swordswoman who would absolutely crush it in the Pro League. I can’t help but expect a flashy match！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「I see, so you’re predicting a final showdown between Victoria and Momiji.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, but you never know until the match is actually played. Upsets are more than welcome—good luck to everyone！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「On the other hand, this year, three first-years—including Suzakuin Momiji—have clinched spots in the main tournament.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And get this: those three are all from the same first-year special A-rank 'Takamura Class', believe it or not!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「That's incredible. Their teacher must be top-notch！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It’s quite the lineup; you can already feel the chaos brewing before the opening！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, they’d better put on a show for me！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh, and just as I say that, we've received word from the operations headquarters.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It appears... everything is ready for the first match of the opening round！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Well then, everyone！ Thank you so much for waiting！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The first match of the opening round, Tennouji Victoria versus Arima Rin！ The match will begin shortly！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whooooooah！ It’s time, it’s time, it’s tiiiiime！」

name: Victoria
message: 「This, this right here！ This heat, this energy！ It’s absolutely exciiiiiiting！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I’ve been waiting for this moment foreeeever！ Oh, I love it！ I looooove the Martial Festival！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey Shizuku, let's put on the best performance ever together！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Wait, what？ Shizuku, is something wrong？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「...I'm sorry, Vicky. I'm not feeling very well.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ehhhh！？ Are you okay！？ Should we go to the infirmary！？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「...No, it's not that bad, I'll be fine.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「But I have a match too, and I need to get my condition back in order, so I won't be able to serve as your second for this match.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, I see... If you're not feeling well, that can't be helped. Get better soon, Shizuku！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I'll absolutely win this match on my own, you'll see！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「...Yeah, I'm sure you will. You're strong, Vicky. I think you can win without me just fine.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Shizuku？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Well then... good luck」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ah, they’re gone」

name: Victoria
message: 「I wonder why... they were acting a little strange, weren’t they? Hmmm, I’m worried, but...」

name: Victoria
message: 「...Yeah！ Shizu said they’d be fine, anyway！ I believe in Shizu！」

name: Victoria
message: 「And that’s exactly why I’m going to win! Then I’ll go tell Shizu, ‘I won!’」

name: Victoria
message: 「Alrighty, let’s goooo！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Thanks for waiting！ And now, it’s time for the fighters to enter！」

name: Umpire
message: 「From the East—Martial Arts Division, Year 3, Class A! Tennouji... Victoriaaaaaaaaa!!」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeeeeeeah！！！ Everybody, I’m definitely going to win, so wish me luck！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「From the West—Martial Arts Division, Year 3, Class B! Arima... Rinnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn!!」

name: Rin
message: 「...Looking forward to a good match, Tennouji-san」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah！ Looking forward to it！ But I’m the one who’s gonna win, okay? Right, everyone?！」

name: Audience Member A
message: 「Go Vicky, you can do it！」

name: Audience Member B
message: 「We’re rooting for you！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Thank you！ Thanks, thanks so much！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I’ll definitely give everyone the best match ever, so stay tuned and enjoy until the very end！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh! Victoria has already won the crowd over! What an incredible roar of cheers!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「She’s the reigning Toujinegi and has a charming personality to boot. No wonder she’s so popular. She sure knows how to keep the fans happy！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ooh！ This is it, this is exactly it！ It’s the beeeest！！」
It’s no exaggeration to say I live for this very moment！
Hurry, hurry, let the match start already！

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now then, both fighters appear to be ready！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The first match of the Martial Festival that everyone’s been waiting for is finally about to begin！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Both parties, take your stances！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes！ Ready...！」
The Umpire gave me a stern look just now, but I don’t care！
More importantly, as I draw my Origami, I can feel my Tenju rising more and more！

name: Victoria
message: （Yes, yes！ Shizu’s tuning is the best, as always！ Thank you, Shizu！）
She’s probably resting now, so I’ll just thank her in my heart！

name: Umpire
message: 「Summoning the myriad gods to gather for the divine council, to deliberate in divine conference. Heaven and earth are pure, the six senses are purified; be cast out, be cleansed...！」

name: Umpire
message: 「On the East side, Tennouji Victoria！」

name: Umpire
message: 「On the West side, Arima Rin！」

name: Umpire
message: 「—Bagua raised high, face one another, no waiting！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Let the match begin！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah！ Here we go！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yee-haw！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...As expected, Victoria seems to be in top form.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「She’s really on a roll, huh~」
Watching the match from the spectator seats, I was—astonished by her strength.
Her blows, even the ones that looked like light swings, possessed enough destructive power to make her opponent slide backward even while blocking.
Her opponent—Arima Rin—also seemed to have sensed early on that she shouldn’t take those hits head-on.
She was trying desperately to deflect them at an angle rather than taking them frontally, but...

name: Victoria
message: 「I’m just getting started！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「A swing to the sides followed by a body strike！ That’s some solid damage！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「A strike following a feint is basic, but there aren’t many who can keep up with that kind of speed.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「As we can see from her reaching the main tournament, Rin is a top-class competitor even among the third-years.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「She’s an all-rounder with the spirit, technique, and physique to match; she even dealt a loss to Kuki Asahi, who is also competing in the main tournament, during the qualifiers.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Victoria doesn't leave many openings either. If Rin wants to win, she’s gonna need some serious grit！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now then, Rin! Can you show us that grit!」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, hey！ Let’s turn up the heat even more！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm... Victoria-senpai was definitely strong, but was she always this incredible...？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Her power and speed both look like they’re on a completely different level than they were in the qualifiers.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, it’s not like her psycho-sensing value stays constant all the time.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even you've had it fluctuate depending on your motivation and focus, haven't you, Setsugekka？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, sure, a little bit, I guess...」

name: Iori
message: 「She's probably the type with a wide swing. Apparently there are a lot of people like that, especially among pro players.」
...Still, it's rare to see a swing this big.
Victoria-san's mental resonance value right now has ballooned to several times what it was during her practice match with Momiji. Those numbers are anything but normal.
Up against a monster―class swordswoman like that, someone of ordinary ability wouldn't stand a―

name: Victoria
message: 「No！ What a nice counter~！」

name: Rin
message: 「All right, now's my chance...！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Nnaaaaaaaaah！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa！ Rin follows up right off her counter！ She's really showing her grit here~！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「...Heh, I see. Looks like there's someone doing something pretty interesting.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And sensing her chance to decide the match, Rin presses the attack even harder！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, didn't things suddenly get dangerous？！ Being able to push back someone as strong as Victoria-senpai—that upperclassman's pretty amazing too！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, there's no doubt she's strong, but... Victoria-san is taking those hits on purpose.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh, on purpose？ You mean she's holding back？」

name: Iori
message: 「Less holding back, more throwing defense out the window. Probably to get the crowd hyped up.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hyaaaaaaaaah！」

name: Rin
message: 「Not done yet...！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Victoria's movements are intense, but... none of her attacks are landing! At this rate, she's a sitting duck~!」

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay, now we're getting started！ Here I come~！」

name: Rin
message: 「Why you...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ouch！ I'm not done yet either~！！」
They trade blows back and forth, whittling away at each other's Barrier Jackets.
Rin-san has landed overwhelmingly more strikes. And probably in total damage dealt to her opponent, too.
Yet Victoria-san doesn't look fazed in the slightest. If anything, Rin-san—who appears to be on the offensive—is the one wearing down.

name: Iori
message: （Now that is some incredible toughness...）
Arakawa is like an immortal zombie that keeps getting back up no matter how many times you knock her down.
Compared to her, Victoria is more like a giant dragon that takes every hit and shrugs it off.

name: Rin
message: 「That's it... stay down！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「G-ggghhh...！」
Rin's full-powered strike landed true, and Victoria went rolling away with a loud cry.
Even so, she got right back up.

name: Victoria
message: 「Nghhh... excellent！ You're pretty good~！」

name: Spectator A
message: 「Hey, hey! Isn't her opponent super strong!？」

name: Spectator B
message: 「Vicky, hang in there！」

name: Spectator C
message: 「Don't lose here！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah！ Of course！ I'm only just getting started！」

name: Rin
message: 「I can't believe you still have the energy for this...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Everyone's cheering is just making me feel even better！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Alrighty then, time to unleash my finishing move~！！」
At that announcement, the crowd went wilder than ever.
Some were even standing up in their excitement—

name: Victoria
message: 「Listen well, you impudent, unfilial lot who dare to bring harm to the Shogun！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「There it is！ Victoria's signature catchphrase！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Ohhh！ That's awesome！ I love stuff like this！」

name: Rin
message: 「I won't let you use it！！」
Naturally, Rin charged in to try and stop her.
And that attack—

name: Victoria
message: 「Now that the great Okita-kun is here, I won't let you do as you please！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Our Tennen Rishin-ryuu is the number one sword style under the heavens！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa! Victoria isn't dodging! She's taking every hit! And she isn't flinching at all while taking them!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And now, here it comes at last...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「And with that, here is today's rush forecast~！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Right now, I'm feeling like... yes！ Fifteen Blade！！！」
A massive number of blades lined up around Victoria-san.

name: Iori
message: （That's right, this is what she showed at last year's Martial Festival too—）
And virtually no one can withstand this.

name: Victoria
message: 「—Ethereal Phantasm, Sonic Rush！！！」

name: Rin
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaaaaaaaah！！」
A hailstorm of thrusts, each one packing lethal power. Left with no way to counter it.

name: Umpire
message: 「Match decided！！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「The destruction of Western side Arima Rin's Barrier Jacket is confirmed！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Therefore, victory goes to Eastern side Tennouji Victoria！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「I-It's overrrr！ Contestant Victoria takes the win in dazzling, show-stopping style！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeaaaaaaaaaaaaah！！！」

name: Spectator A
message: 「Now that's our Toujinegi！」

name: Spectator B
message: 「Way to go, Vicky！」

name: Spectator C
message: 「You've got this year's Toujinegi title in the bag too!!」
Amidst thunderous cheers, Victoria-san thrust her fist into the air onstage, flashing her brightest smile at the crowd.
Meanwhile, Momiji and Setsugekka wore grim expressions as they watched the match.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Do you think we can really beat someone like that？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Who knows. Still, we don't have a choice but to try.」
Overwhelming speed and power. She had put on a display truly worthy of the reigning Toujinegi.

name: Iori
message: 「You don't need to look so gloomy.」

name: Iori
message: 「Sure, Victoria-san is strong. But the two of you have grown just as strong.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm not just saying this to comfort or reassure you.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm the one who's watched all of you fight up close, so there's no mistake. All that's left is to give it everything you've got！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah... you're right. I'll do my best！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I don’t intend to lose from the start, you know.」
Saying that, the two of them showed us their smiles.
